name: keepassnc
description: KeePass (KDBX) files in the browser, for Nextcloud and WebDAV. Decrypted only in the browser.

scripts.build: node tools/build.mjs && node tools/build-nextcloud.mjs && node tools/build-pass.mjs
scripts.test: npm run build && npm run test:unit && npm run test:compat && npm run test:e2e && npm run test:ui && npm run test:theme && npm run test:keyfile && npm run test:credentials && npm run test:create && npm run test:remote && npm run test:offline && npm run test:fidelity && npm run test:pass
scripts.package:nc: npm run build && tar czf keepassnc-nextcloud-app.tar.gz -C nextcloud-app keepassnc
